highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 upgrades to Skia m150 and adds image-filter, overdraw, and fast-bounds APIs.
highlights_body: This release also improves surface canvas performance, fixes a raster blur regression, and refreshes bundled HarfBuzz.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer moves to Skia m150 and incorporates its upstream stabilization fixes.
Adds crop and empty image filters, an overdraw color filter, and SKPaint.GetFastBounds for quick-reject culling.
Restores the efficient raster pipeline behavior for small blur radii.

bullets.lead: Surface canvas access avoids repeated wrapper allocation
bullets.detail: SKSurface caches its managed Canvas wrapper across calls, reducing overhead in canvas-heavy applications.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Improved SKSurface canvas wrapper performance and fixed small-sigma raster blurs

preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m150 release line.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added the core m150 APIs, performance work, and HarfBuzz refresh.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 completed the new graphics APIs and raster blur fix.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library to 14.2.1.
